facts.text: Spalding University structures undergraduate coursework into flexible 8-week block sessions, allowing students to focus intensively on courses followed by a scheduled break.

sources.title: Block Schedule - Spalding University
sources.quote: In an effort to enhance the academic experience, Spalding University is transitioning from the traditional 6-week course sessions to a more structured 8-week format.

sources.title: Block Schedule - Spalding University
sources.quote: It's eight weeks of learning followed by a break before your next session of classes. With this schedule, you have the flexibility to decide, every eight weeks, how you want to structure your courses.
